It is further submitted that as per the case of the prosecution, the accused No.1 has good terms with the complainant due to which complainant has given certain amount to accused No.1 for the purpose of running business and as per the instructions issued by the accused No.1, an amount of rupees fifty lakh has been deposited by the complainant in the account of the present applicant accused.
It is submitted that the said amount is subsequently redeposited by the present applicant accused in the account of the accused No.1 and said fact is clearly found out from the police papers.
It is further submitted that in fact present applicant accused had never come into contact with the complainant and applicant accused has not given any assurance to the complainant.
The applicant accused has not received a single penny from the aforesaid transaction.

It is further submitted that as per the case of the prosecution, the amount was deposited by the complainant in the account of the present applicant accused at the instance of the accused No.1 in the year 2018 even though the complainant has not taken any steps till 2023 and suddenly filed complaint in the year NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/23105/2023 ORDER DATED: 16/01/2024 undefined 2023.
Thus, there was delay of 6 years in registering the FIR.
Considering the above stated factual aspects, applicant may be enlarged on bail by imposing suitable terms and conditions.
4. Learned APP appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has opposed grant of regular bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.

Learned APP further submits that the involvement of the present applicant accused is found out from the very beginning and amount has already been deposited by the complainant in the account of the present applicant accused.

It is further submitted that during the course of investigation, it is found out that number of transactions have been carried out by the accused No.3 in favour of accused No.1 as a business transaction.
Learned APP submits that considering the role attributed to the applicant accused, his bail application may not be considered.

5. Learned advocate Mr. Jasani appearing on behalf of the original complainant has objected present application with vehemence and submitted that involvement of the present applicant accused has been found out from the very inception.

It is further submitted that all the accused persons have hatched a conspiracy to dupe the complainant and as a part of conspiracy they have acted in a particular manner and at the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/23105/2023 ORDER DATED: 16/01/2024 undefined instance of accused No.1, the complainant has deposited the amount in the account of accused Nos. 2 and 3, which they have siphoned away.
Considering the same, bail application of the applicant may not be considered.
6. Learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties do not press for further reasoned order.

7. I have heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers of the investigation and considered the allegations levelled against the applicant and the role played by the applicant.
It is found out from the record that applicant has been arrested on 14.08.2023 and since then he is in judicial custody.
The investigation is already concluded and after submission of charge-sheet, present application is preferred.
